summary: Allows arbitrary constant scalar expressions (not only literals or dynamic parameters) in OFFSET, from parser and validator through RelBuilder, planner rules, metadata, Enumerable execution and dialect unparsing.

tests.evidence: New feature across parser, validator, rules, rel2sql and execution; the PR adds tests in each (offset.iq, RelOptRulesTest, RelToSqlConverterTest, JdbcTest, ServerTest, SqlParserTest), and reviewers' test questions (SqlValidatorTest 'Why did this test pass?') were already addressed before this head.

user_docs.evidence: New SQL syntax; site/_docs/reference.md grammar and prose are updated for OFFSET { start | expression } and the column/aggregate restrictions.

doc_comments.evidence: New public RexUtil methods (makeOffsetFetchSum, validateOffsetValue, reduceOffsetToLiteral) and a changed RelBuilder.sortLimit contract; each carries Javadoc, and the non-obvious CEIL(offset)+CEIL(fetch) rounding is explained.

change_description.evidence: The description covers only the OFFSET syntax, not the unrelated behavior changes bundled in (MySQL/SQLite OFFSET-only unparsed as LIMIT <max>/-1, EnumerableMergeUnionRule ceil rounding, SortUnionTransposeRule now firing with OFFSET); a reviewer asked for the PR title to be refined and for a summary of why existing tests were modified.

performance.evidence: SortUnionTransposeRule and EnumerableMergeUnionRule now push OFFSET+FETCH into inputs, a plan-shape change; no hot-path code touched.

security.evidence: No auth, crypto, or untrusted-input handling beyond ordinary SQL parsing grammar.

backward_compat.evidence: Public RelBuilder.sortLimit now accepts non-literal OFFSET, protected SqlDialect.unparseOffset now throws IllegalArgumentException for expressions, CalciteResource fetch* methods renamed (added in unreleased CALCITE-7592, so tolerable), and MySQL/SQLite unparsing of OFFSET-only queries changes.

error_model.evidence: Validator messages generalized to {0} for OFFSET/FETCH plus a new 'OFFSET must not be negative' error; new IllegalArgumentException in SqlDialect.unparseOffset and RelBuilder validation messages.

correctness.evidence: Non-trivial logic in many rules (RelMdMinRowCount default offset, RelMdUtil, SortJoin/SortUnionTranspose, RelDecorrelator, EnumerableMergeUnionRule rounding); adapters at base still cast sort.offset to RexLiteral (MongoSort.java:87, DruidRules.java:859, CassandraLimit.java:62), a risk a focused pass should check though dynamic parameters already reached them.

user_value.evidence: New SQL feature motivated by parity with PostgreSQL, Oracle, H2 and SQL Server; reviewers did not question its value.

surprising_behavior.evidence: OFFSET accepts unparenthesized expressions while FETCH still requires parentheses; documented in reference.md.

contradictions.evidence: SqlParserTest.java: the comment 'Arithmetic and scalar expressions are allowed within parentheses' now sits directly above a test of 'offset 1 + abs(-2)' without parentheses; a reviewer also asked why that comment was modified.

build_ci.evidence: Parser.jj grammar changes only; no build scripts, CI, or dependencies.

spec_conformance.evidence: Extends SQL:2008 <result offset clause> and the per-dialect LIMIT/OFFSET unparsing; a reviewer asked for verification against MySQL and other databases, answered with a PostgreSQL run.

plan.why: Large cross-cutting change: planner/runtime logic, SQL and dialect semantics, and the prose surfaces each need a separate focused pass.
